newsitem.title: USA: U.S. LPG market lackluster in dead trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. LPG market lackluster in dead trade.

text.p: U.S. liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) prices were steady to lower in thin activity late Monday with players continuing to focus on setting contract prices for March.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, offers for spot propane drifted down a quarter cent to 38.50 cents with buyers holding out at 38.25 cents. Conway, Kansas, material was assessed steady in lackluster dealings.
The other liquids were also quiet, and were ranged widely due to the lack of trade, players said.
Belvieu normal butane remained 45.00/46.00 cents and Conway too was steady .
